content:
elaine: Heads up: sample-app reports wildly different rerank results in private vs public. SDK v1.3.0 seems to drop candidate_weights; curl works.
tom: Paste repro?
elaine: curl -> sends candidate_weights snake_case and scores bias to second candidate. SDK -> sends candidateWeights camelCase and returns uniform scores.
hugo: Why did SDK change casing for this endpoint? serializer shim?
elaine: Looks like general camel-caser applied globally. Public proxy accepts both, private rerank service ignores unknown fields. Customers see "model changed".
infra-bot: Created platform issue #4610 to add strict schema check behind flag for private clusters.
tom: Also noticed auth retry behavior: SDK auto-refresh -> multiple 401s -> circuit opens. curl shows single 401. We should not auto-retry 401 in private by default.
qa: I'll add CI test to compare raw payloads and a nightly private smoke test for expired tokens.
hugo: Action: 1) quick SDK serializer patch to preserve candidate_weights for rerank (tom). 2) infra to add strict validation flag (infra). 3) docs: sample-app note about using request_body override until patch.
elaine: Thanks, will update quickstart and add regression test.
